documents.heading: Ceramic planter maintenance
documents.body: Handmade ceramic planters require gentle watering. Use a drainage tray to prevent pooling water under indoor clay pots. Let soil dry slightly before watering houseplants. Ceramic pot cleaning uses mild soap and a soft cloth.

documents.heading: Robots.txt directives
documents.body: A robots.txt file communicates crawling preferences to compatible web crawlers. The Disallow directive restricts crawler access to matching paths. Robots.txt is not an authentication mechanism or a reliable method to hide private information.

documents.heading: Canonical URL selection
documents.body: The rel canonical link element identifies a preferred URL among duplicate or similar pages. Canonical signals are hints and search engines can choose a different canonical. Avoid contradictory canonical declarations on the same page.

documents.heading: PostgreSQL vector indexing
documents.body: PostgreSQL pgvector provides vector similarity search with cosine distance and HNSW indexing. A full-text GIN index can accelerate lexical keyword matching using tsvector and plainto_tsquery functions.

documents.heading: Kitchen cooking guide
documents.body: Cooking a simple lentil soup uses onions carrots herbs broth and a simmering pot. Wash produce carefully before chopping vegetables. Serve the soup warm with bread.
